prompt: Single continuous shot. Opens mid-action: guanciale cubes hitting a dry hot pan, fat rendering loudly, cubes turning amber and crisping. The camera glides to egg yolks dropping one by one into a bowl of grated cheese, whisked into a thick golden paste in macro. Hot spaghetti tossed into the pork fat, pan pulled OFF the flame — money shot: the yolk-cheese paste poured over the steaming strands and tossed fast, transforming into a silky pale-gold cream that coats and drips from the lifting tongs in extreme macro, backlit steam curling. Final beat: the plated nest showered with black pepper cracked from height, crisp guanciale scattered on top. Warm light, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: the rendering crackle, then the tossing slide. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
